# Nano Empire AI - Machine-to-Machine (M2M) Capabilities

> Nano Empire AI sells signed behavioral proof of agent skills and MCP servers (SkillProof) and metered machine APIs (RecallGuard US recall data). Prices are published for HTTP 402 / x402 settlement in USDC.
> Status as of 2026-09-29: paper_mode = true. No paid machine transaction or receipt has been verified yet. Every endpoint URL below answered on 2026-09-29: HTTP 200, or 402 where marked as a paywall. Server base URLs are prefixes, not endpoints.

## Servers (in order)
1. **RecallGuard primary**: `https://recallguard-api.vercel.app` (HTTPS, open access, endpoints under `/api/v1`; human docs at /docs)
2. **RecallGuard secondary**: host 147.5.105.20 port 8420, plain HTTP, DEBUG build, x402 configured, 100 free calls (health: `http://147.5.105.20:8420/health`)
3. **SkillProof quote box**: host 147.5.105.20 port 8405, plain HTTP (health: `http://147.5.105.20:8405/health`)
4. **api.nanoempireai.com**: `/v1/*` not deployed (404) as of 2026-09-29. Do not call it for RecallGuard, trial, or SkillProof.

## Status (2026-09-29)

| RecallGuard feed + match | available (paper mode, no paid receipt) |
| IRV advisory + feed | building (no public endpoint returns 200) |
| SkillProof | human / Stripe (no x402 verify path answers) |
| SkillProof quote box triage | responds 200 without payment (paywall not enforced) |
| SkillProof quote box audit | responds 402 with an L402-style placeholder challenge, not x402; paid delivery unverified |

## Free Calls
- 100 free calls on the secondary RecallGuard server (`free_quota: 100`), then HTTP 402.
- The primary RecallGuard server is open and does not issue a 402 today.
- No trial-token endpoint is deployed.

## x402 Example Interaction

1. **Agent** discovers spec:
   `GET https://nanoempireai.com/openapi.json`

2. **Agent** claims trial:
   ```http
   POST /v1/trial
   Content-Type: application/json
   {"agent_id": "my_shopping_bot", "client": "openclaw"}

   → 200 OK {"trial_token": "trial_abc123...", "credits": 50}
   ```

3. **Agent** executes free call:
   ```http
   POST /v1/recallguard/match
   Authorization: Bearer trial_abc123...
   Content-Type: application/json
   {"items": [{"item": "Power Bank", "brand": "Anker"}]}

   → 200 OK {"tier": "trial", "matches": [...]}
   ```

3. **Agent** exhausts credits → 402 Challenge:
   ```http
   HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
   {
     "x402Version": 1,
     "error": "Payment Required",
     "accepts": [{
       "scheme": "exact",
       "network": "eip155:8453",
       "maxAmountRequired": "50000",
       "resource": "/v1/recallguard/feed",
       "description": "RecallGuard Feed",
       "mimeType": "application/json",
       "payTo": "0x90E23A7b6F6494A879d05DDC4278D0e55Dec1e01",
       "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
       "maxTimeoutSeconds": 60
     }]
   }
   ```

4. **Agent** pays via x402 (Base USDC) → gets receipt → continues.

## Not Deployed (as of 2026-09-29)
- api.nanoempireai.com `/v1/*`: trial, recallguard, skillproof verify, wallet top-up (all 404)
- IRV advisory, feed, webhook, corpus: building
- Trial-token onramp, usage/billing/receipt endpoints: not deployed on any listed server

## SDK
- Python metering SDK: `pip install nano-empire-tollbooth` (https://pypi.org/project/nano-empire-tollbooth/)

## Discovery Files
- **OpenAPI 3.1**: `https://nanoempireai.com/openapi.json` (per-path servers, x-price / x-402 hints, x-paper-mode)
- **Offers Catalog**: `https://nanoempireai.com/offers.json`
- **A2A Agent Card**: `https://nanoempireai.com/.well-known/agent-card.json` (unsigned; discovery only, A2A task endpoint not implemented)
- **MCP Manifest**: `https://nanoempireai.com/mcp-manifest.json`
- A mirror of the agent card is staged for the path /agents.json (not deployed as of 2026-09-29).
